name: list_contacts
description: List/search contacts (subscribers) in an ActiveCampaign account. Filter by exact email or a free-text search across name/email. Returns contacts with IDs, emails, names, and meta.total.

account.description: Your ActiveCampaign account URL or subdomain, e.g. "https://youraccount.api-us1.com" or just "youraccount".

email.description: Filter to an exact email address.

search.description: Free-text search across name and email.

name: get_contact
description: Get a single contact by ID. Returns email, name, phone, custom field values, and engagement details.

account.description: Your ActiveCampaign account URL or subdomain, e.g. "https://youraccount.api-us1.com" or just "youraccount".

name: list_deals
description: List CRM deals (sales pipeline opportunities). Returns deal IDs, titles, values, stages, and owners with meta.total.

account.description: Your ActiveCampaign account URL or subdomain, e.g. "https://youraccount.api-us1.com" or just "youraccount".

name: list_campaigns
description: List email campaigns with send/open/click metrics. Returns campaign IDs, names, status, send dates, and aggregate stats.

account.description: Your ActiveCampaign account URL or subdomain, e.g. "https://youraccount.api-us1.com" or just "youraccount".

name: list_lists
description: List contact lists. Returns list IDs, names, subscriber counts, and creation dates.

account.description: Your ActiveCampaign account URL or subdomain, e.g. "https://youraccount.api-us1.com" or just "youraccount".

name: list_automations
description: List marketing automations (workflows). Returns automation IDs, names, status, and enrolled-contact counts.

account.description: Your ActiveCampaign account URL or subdomain, e.g. "https://youraccount.api-us1.com" or just "youraccount".
